# MiniShop POS remaining development roadmap

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-progress.mjs from progress/development-progress.json. -->

Last reviewed: 2026-10-18 (Asia/Manila). Phase: Software acceptance and bounded reliability verified; shop device and operational gates pending.

Priorities below are ordered by counter-operation impact and dependencies. External acceptance is required where marked; documentation alone cannot close a release gate.

## 1. Production TLS, roles and secret handling

Status: **Needs verification** · Release gate.

Why: Protect the operational database and sessions before involving other shop devices.

Acceptance: Approved certificate trust, separated service/provisioner access, renewal and new non-demo operational credentials pass acceptance; keep the implemented fictional staging environment separate.

Dependencies: None; can start independently..

Reviewed source: [src/MiniShop.Api/Program.cs](../src/MiniShop.Api/Program.cs), [docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md), [docs/STAGING_GUIDE.md](../docs/STAGING_GUIDE.md), [src/MiniShop.Api/Data/RuntimeDatabasePolicy.cs](../src/MiniShop.Api/Data/RuntimeDatabasePolicy.cs), [tests/MiniShop.Tests/SecurityTests.cs](../tests/MiniShop.Tests/SecurityTests.cs).

## 2. Trusted HTTPS LAN and WAN-loss drill

Status: **Blocked** · Release gate.

Why: The shop must remain usable when external internet disconnects.

Acceptance: A phone and second PC complete checkout and repayments through WAN loss and reconnection using trusted HTTPS.

Dependencies: Production TLS, roles and secret handling.

Reviewed source: [docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md), [docs/STAGING_GUIDE.md](../docs/STAGING_GUIDE.md), [docs/LAN_GUIDE.md](../docs/LAN_GUIDE.md), [src/MiniShop.Api/Authentication/LanSecurity.cs](../src/MiniShop.Api/Authentication/LanSecurity.cs).

## 3. Physical thermal printer acceptance

Status: **Blocked** · Release gate.

Why: Receipt failures directly interrupt counter operations.

Acceptance: Owner accepts both intended paper widths, long receipts, reprinting and the actual cutter/driver behavior.

Dependencies: 58 mm, settings and archival identity.

Reviewed source: [docs/USER_MANUAL.md](../docs/USER_MANUAL.md), [src/minishop-web/e2e/shop-devices.spec.ts](../src/minishop-web/e2e/shop-devices.spec.ts), [docs/SHOP_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE.md](../docs/SHOP_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE.md).

## 4. Physical barcode scanner acceptance

Status: **Blocked** · Release gate.

Why: Validate fast and accurate scanning with the hardware cashiers will actually use.

Acceptance: Rapid repeated scans, focus recovery and unknown codes preserve the expected cart quantities.

Dependencies: None; can start independently..

Reviewed source: [src/minishop-web/src/pages/Pos.tsx](../src/minishop-web/src/pages/Pos.tsx), [src/minishop-web/src/pages/Pos.tsx](../src/minishop-web/src/pages/Pos.tsx), [src/minishop-web/src/pages/Pos.test.tsx](../src/minishop-web/src/pages/Pos.test.tsx), [docs/SHOP_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE.md](../docs/SHOP_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE.md).

## 5. Employee lifecycle and revoked sessions

Status: **Needs verification**.

Why: Account revocation and recovery need dedicated evidence before workers use the system.

Acceptance: Creation, deactivate/reactivate, password reset and all existing-session revocation checks pass.

Dependencies: None; can start independently..

Reviewed source: [src/MiniShop.Api/Controllers/AdminController.cs](../src/MiniShop.Api/Controllers/AdminController.cs), [src/minishop-web/src/pages/Admin.tsx](../src/minishop-web/src/pages/Admin.tsx), [tests/MiniShop.Tests/SecurityTests.cs](../tests/MiniShop.Tests/SecurityTests.cs).

## 6. Managed startup and operational recovery

Status: **In progress** · Release gate.

Why: A backup file alone is not an operational recovery procedure.

Acceptance: A restarted managed app and a restored copy reconcile stock, cash/credit totals and the last receipt with an operator present.

Dependencies: Production TLS, roles and secret handling.

Reviewed source: [scripts/Start.ps1](../scripts/Start.ps1), [scripts/Verify-Backup.ps1](../scripts/Verify-Backup.ps1), [docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md), [scripts/Test-StagingBackup.ps1](../scripts/Test-StagingBackup.ps1).

## 7. Independent security and invoicing acceptance

Status: **Blocked** · Release gate.

Why: Commercial rollout requires qualified acceptance outside the codebase.

Acceptance: Owner records external review decisions and all blocking findings are resolved.

Dependencies: Production TLS, roles and secret handling; Trusted HTTPS LAN and WAN-loss drill; Physical thermal printer acceptance; Managed startup and operational recovery.

Reviewed source: [docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md](../docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md), [docs/USER_MANUAL.md](../docs/USER_MANUAL.md).

## Remaining verification and capacity work

- **Validation, empty and error states (Needs verification):** Exercise server validation, timeout, loading and empty states on every operational page.
- **Keyboard and mobile accessibility (Needs verification):** Run keyboard-only, screen-reader, contrast and representative phone/browser acceptance.
- **Large-catalog and ledger navigation (In progress):** Add server-paged customer/batch/ledger navigation and test representative data volumes.
- **58 mm, settings and archival identity (Needs verification):** Complete actual printer/configuration acceptance and decide/implement immutable historical receipt identity where required.
- **Inventory, credit and CSV reports (Needs verification):** Reconcile inventory/credit/date-range exports to fixture totals and inspect them in target spreadsheet tools.
- **Soak, power failure and browser matrix (In progress):** Extend bounded tests to long-duration load, crash/power interruption and actual supported browsers, with operator-reviewed reconciliation.
- **Cloud deployment packaging preparation (In progress):** Choose a hosting target and prepare staging manifests, managed PostgreSQL, secrets and health probes.
- **Versioned outbox event contract (Not started):** Design and review the event contract and reconciliation invariants before implementing synchronization.
- **Cloud monitoring and recovery runbook (In progress):** Create a target-specific staging, monitoring, rollback and disaster-recovery runbook.

## Later optional features

- Partial line refunds and exchanges
- Expenses, cash-drawer shifts and net-profit accounting
- Direct printer/spooler integration beyond browser printing
- A dark theme and additional visual customization
- Bidirectional cloud synchronization (explicitly outside the initial release)

## Release decision

There are 6 open gates. The owner should accept a rollout only after actual device/network/security/recovery/commercial checks are recorded and blocking findings are resolved. A percentage alone cannot authorize deployment. See [progress](../PROGRESS.md) and [maintenance](PROGRESS_MAINTENANCE.md).
